summary: Armour Residential REIT filed an 8-K confirming routine monthly cash dividends on its common stock ($0.24 per share for July 2026) and Series C Preferred Stock ($0.14583 per share per month for Q3 2026). The filing includes record and payment dates; no tender offer, merger, buyback, or corporate action is described. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
